info.name: Get paginated search results of VOD and Live streams

params.name: offset
params.description: Index of the first item to return, starting at 0. Default is 0

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return. Default is 25, maximum is 100

params.name: query
params.description: Query to search for in a streams' title, description and ID

params.name: type
params.description: Type of stream to search for

params.name: status
params.description: Status of the streams to search for

params.name: createdBefore
params.description: Upper limit for the creation date of found streams as UTC in ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

params.name: createdAfter
params.description: Lower limit for the creation date of found streams as UTC in ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

items.docs: Get paginated search results of VOD and Live streams
